source.source_locator: 教則 第6章 6.4「夜間飛行」(1)夜間飛行の運航

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 夜間飛行は灯火装備だけでなく、安全な場所での事前訓練を前提とする。
evidence.tested_misconception: 昼間経験または灯火装備があれば夜間特有の訓練は不要である。
evidence.reasoning_path: night-specific skill demand -> safe training environment -> competency preparation -> operational readiness

collision.note: LOW。既存のnight lighting coverageと分離し、操縦者training readinessを問う。

independent_review.rationale: 6.4 requires prior night training in a safe no-third-party place; distinct from Q100 lighting controls.

director_adjudication.rationale: Independent reviewer evidence is source-consistent and correctly distinguishes integration/decision-boundary variants from exact semantic collisions.
